notes: Hiding uses the `hidden` attribute rather than conditional rendering, which is what keeps the panel mounted. The stylesheet restates `[hidden] { display: none }` because any `display` rule on the root would otherwise beat the attribute.
Props spread before role, id, aria-labelledby, tabIndex and hidden, so a caller cannot un-hide an unselected panel or repoint its label.
There is no exit for lazy content: React renders children whether or not the panel is hidden. A consumer who needs deferral has to guard inside their own children.
